title: Richard Sherman's Insight: Who Seahawks Fans Should Be Thrilled About This Season
htmlContent:
The 2023 NFL season has dawned upon us, and for ardent Seattle Seahawks fans, the excitement and anticipation are reaching fever pitch. As the team gears up for another campaign, former Seahawks cornerback and NFL luminary Richard Sherman shared his thoughts on the players who should have the 12s buzzing with excitement in an exclusive interview with King 5 News.

Sherman, a Super Bowl champion and a revered figure in Seattle's football history, provided invaluable insights into the individuals who could shape the Seahawks' fortunes this season.

"Bobby Wagner is the thing you should be most excited about because that defense has leadership and identity," Sherman asserted confidently, putting the spotlight squarely on the veteran linebacker. Bobby Wagner, a perennial All-Pro and a consummate leader, remains the bedrock of the Seahawks' defense. His presence not only commands respect but also provides direction to a unit with high expectations.

Sherman's mention of Bobby Wagner underscores the significance of having an established leader in the locker room, a figure who can galvanize the team during the toughest moments of a game or a season. Wagner's impact goes beyond statistics; it's about setting the tone and instilling a winning mentality.

However, Sherman's excitement didn't end with Wagner. He also highlighted the emergence of Quandre Diggs and Julian Love as a dynamic safety duo. "Now, Quandre Diggs is freaking looking really fantastic. Julian Love. That combination is gonna be one of the best safety tandems in the National Football League," Sherman proclaimed.

The safety position is critical in today's NFL, where versatile players are required to cover wide receivers, support in the run game, and create turnovers. The potential of Diggs and Love to excel in these areas is undoubtedly a source of enthusiasm for Seahawks fans.

Sherman's optimism extended to the offensive side of the ball, where the Seahawks have been known for their explosiveness. "Just that offense in general, it's gonna be so explosive," he stated with a grin. Seattle's offense, led by offensive coordinator Shane Waldron, is poised to captivate fans with its innovative and high-scoring approach.

Sherman saved his most effusive praise for quarterback Geno Smith, who will be steering the ship while Russell Wilson recovers from an injury. "Geno, my goodness, Geno looks really good. I mean, he looked great last season. I think he's gonna look even better this season," Sherman opined.

Geno Smith, once viewed as a backup, has showcased growth and poise in his game, instilling confidence in the coaching staff and fans alike. Sherman's endorsement of Geno Smith's potential only adds to the excitement surrounding the Seahawks' offense this season.

As Seahawks enthusiasts eagerly await the kickoff of the 2023 NFL season, Richard Sherman's insights serve as a reminder of the wealth of talent and promise within the team. From veteran leaders like Bobby Wagner to rising stars in the secondary and the explosive offensive potential led by Geno Smith, there's a lot for the 12s to be excited about this season. The journey ahead promises exhilarating moments, and with players like these, the Seahawks are poised to make their mark once again in the NFL.
